newsitem.title: GERMANY: S&P-Hypo on creditwatch with positive implications.
newsitem.headline: S&P-Hypo on creditwatch with positive implications.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it has placed its ratings on Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechselbank AG on CreditWatch with "positive implications" on plans it will merger with Bayerische Vereinsbank AG.
S&P also said it affirmed its ratings on Vereinsbank.

"The rating actions are based on the potential for a stronger market position of the new group in its core markets, a certain degree of cost savings and the low level of additional financial risk incurred," S&P said in a statement.

S&P said the proposed merger structure will involve no additional debt and should have a neutral impact on the new group's capitalisation through the combination of a share swap and a subsequent capital increase for the new bank.
S&P said it rated Bayerische Hypo-Bank AG as A+/A-1 on counterparty ratings, A+/A-1 for commercial paper A+/A-1 and A for subordinated debt.
At Vereinsbank, S&P said its counterparty rating was A-1+. On CD's, the rating was A-1+ and A-1+ on commercial paper.
